intent: Preserve and index bounded photo metadata and XMP sidecars, expose privacy-aware multidimensional query, map, Agent, upload, and metadata-inspector workflows.

findings.title: Namespace-qualified XMP values were not normalized
Metadata JSON byte limit was not exact after escaping
Advanced LIKE filters interpreted user wildcards
Agent distance output enabled location triangulation
Whole-world map viewport collapsed at 180 degrees
Common photo filters were clipped at narrower workspace widths
Mobile filter height made photo and map results unreachable

advisory: Run target amd64 and arm64 acceptance with representative camera RAW/EXIF/IPTC/XMP/ICC/JFIF files and real ffprobe video metadata.
Validate representative raster PMTiles tile directories and intentionally corrupt payloads on mounted and offline NAS pools.
Back up SQLite and stop writers before migration 019; rollback requires restoring the matching database backup.

verification.tests: passed: 110 Vitest files, 699 tests with 4 skipped, plus Rust and documentation tests
verification.build: passed with non-failing Vite chunk-size advisory
verification.browser: passed at 1440/820/560/390/320 px in dark and light themes, including timeline, local map fallback, mobile viewer, and overflow checks
